title: LGPD Erasure Plan v1
description: Canonical contract for cmd/erasure-worker --plan input. Co-signed by DPO + Compliance Officer per docs/security/data-lifecycle/erasure-workflow.md.

subject_ref.description: Opaque identifier of the data subject (typically a hashed CPF or UUID). Never the raw CPF.

approvals.description: Roles that signed off on the plan. Must include both 'dpo' and 'compliance_officer' (case-insensitive) for --execute to proceed.

table.description: Target table name. Must match CRDB identifier rules; refuses anything that smells like SQL injection.

where.description: WHERE clause body (without the leading WHERE). Empty refuses to mutate the full table.

fields.description: Required for redact (non-empty); forbidden for hard_delete.

comment.description: Free-text note for the audit bundle (e.g. retention rule applied).
